title: Death from Below (errata)
old_text: Kill a unit at a battlefield. Then, if it had 3 [M] or less, you may play this from your trash for [A].
new_text: Kill a unit at a battlefield. Then, if it had 3 [M] or less, do this: You may play this from your trash for [A].
explanation: If the killed unit had 3 Might or less, the trash-play instruction is a reflexive trigger.
